tooltip.applied_oritech.me_extended_patt: Provides 36 pattern slots. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to toggle automatic output return.
tooltip.applied_oritech.me_extended_inte: Provides 36 stock slots using ExtendedAE's paged interface menu.
message.applied_oritech.not_attached: Not attached: place addons against an ME Dock connected to a machine; install the dock in a machine addon slot.
message.applied_oritech.no_dock: No ME Dock on this machine.
message.applied_oritech.dock_online: ME Dock online: %s addon modules connected.
message.applied_oritech.dock_offline: ME Dock offline: check network power and channels.
tooltip.applied_oritech.me_dock: Connects this machine's ME addon modules to an ME network. Each dock and its addons share one channel.
tooltip.applied_oritech.me_pattern_provi: Lets the ME network craft using this machine. Pushes ingredients into the machine's input slots only.
tooltip.applied_oritech.me_interface_add: Keeps the machine's input slots stocked with the items you configure, requesting crafts when they run out.
